judul: The Hidden Cubs of the Lastboss ~A Former Corporate Programmer Reincarnated in a Demon King’s Castle Is Free to Develop a “Magic Code” at Will.~
author: Kumano Genkotsu
synopsis:
Bereinkarnasi ke istana Raja Iblis!?
 Sihir dikembangkan menggunakan skill pemrograman!
 Dan bahkan Raja Iblis pun mengakui sihir itu——?
